concerns.text: FR-009 states the system MUST calibrate the simulation cost model parameters against standard published CPU I/O bandwidth values before running experiments, but it does not specify how this calibration will be verified (e.g., a calibration report, recorded parameter values, or citation of the source values). Without an explicit verification artifact, the requirement is not testable.

FR-014 requires the generated Proxy Graph’s edge overlap values to be sampled from a power‑law distribution with exponent α=2.1 ± 0.2, yet the spec does not mandate reporting or testing that the sampled distribution actually meets this exponent tolerance (e.g., via a goodness‑of‑fit test or parameter log). The lack of a measurable verification step makes the requirement untestable.
